title: GemGame: Cozy Match 3 Puzzle
summary: A cozy match 3 puzzle with no ads and offline play, now in a rich new Velvet design. Swap jewels, chain sparkling cascades and restore a magical garden, one clever move at a time. Discover five connected worlds, from the Living Conservatory to the Heart of the Void. Make clever matches, face each guardian and bring its world back to life. PLAYABLE WITH VOICEOVER GemGame plays with VoiceOver. Every gem and obstacle on the board has a clear spoken label, a Board status element counts obstacles and ingredients, and a Special gems element counts specials. Each move is summarised after it settles, including the chain multiplier. Purchased hints name the exact pair to swap, and rejected moves explain why without spending a move. AWAKEN THE FIVE WORLDS Restore the Conservatory's light, reconnect the Nebula Waterways, unfold the Aurora Observatory, illuminate the Plasma Forge and awaken the Heart of the Void. Your campaign progress makes each transformation permanent. Return to choose free lighting, replay the awakening and pursue optional mastery. LEARN A SPECTACULAR NEXT MOVE Try five world encounters in the free Jewel Lab. Experiment with real puzzle rules and unlimited practice retries, without spending lives or earning campaign rewards. Combine striped, wrapped, rainbow and comet specials, clear obstacles and take on cosmic guardians. A GARDEN WORTH COMING BACK TO Restore fountains, flowering corners and peaceful places to sit. Choose decorative finishes, discover new districts and welcome butterflies, songbirds and other woodland visitors as you play. A LITTLE ADVENTURE, YOUR WAY • Daily Star: a fresh free puzzle each day, with no life cost. Keep your streak going. • Relic Run: draft relics and climb five boards in a single free run. • Weekend Gauntlet: a Friday-to-Sunday sudden-death ladder. How far can you climb? • The Atelier: discover cosmetic themes for your board. MAKE ROOM FOR A COZY MOMENT No ads interrupt your game. Core puzzles work offline, and levels are move-based, so there is no countdown rushing your next swap. Campaign lives refill over time; Daily Star gives you a free daily board without spending a life. GemGame is free to download. The optional Complete Collection is one permanent purchase: all five premium chapter reward tracks plus 50 Hard Mode puzzles. Rewards are earned as you play; the base campaign and garden remain free. Existing chapter-pass or Hard Mode owners receive the collection through Restore Purchases at no extra cost. Coin packs remain optional. Some decorative finishes require premium access. Purchases and Game Center features require an internet connection. Your next little escape is waiting.

title: Motif: Word Challenge
summary: Swap letters and find ten words a day to take on the world. Jump into the adventure of the new Ascension mode! Free, with no ads or account required. Find ten hidden words every day and aim for the highest score on the daily grid! Motif is a strategic word game that combines clever wordplay with match-3-inspired mechanics. Free, ad-free, and no account required. THE WORD GAME WHERE WORDS HIDE! Swap letters, spot words, and plan your next move. Swipe across words to clear them from the grid. Every move shapes what comes next, so choose wisely! Everyone starts with the same grid. Submit your score if you’d like, and see where you rank on the daily leaderboard. NEW ASCENSION MODE! Motif becomes a full-blown adventure! Climb ten increasingly tough levels packed with bosses, special tiles, and bonuses galore. Motif has never played like this—and it’s free! ZEN MODES Want to play without the pressure? Zen Mode gives you fresh grids and the same rules, but with no word limit and no leaderboard. Take your time and play at your own pace. + “À LA CARTE” MODE! You set your own rules: swipe words bottom to top, right to left, in an L shape, use unlimited letter swaps… You call the shots. + M0T1F MODE! This time, numbers take the stage: swipe tiles to add them up and hit the target number. Careful, this one’s dangerously addictive! MAKE IT YOURS Customize Motif to suit your style: fonts, colors, tile shapes, score display, backgrounds… even the app icon. NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ACCOUNT. Just open Motif and start playing. No internet connection is required to play. The leaderboard is entirely optional. If you choose to participate, only your score, the date, and the grid language are submitted. No account, no advertising ID, and no player profile. Individual scores are deleted after 30 days.

title: Dugout Dice
summary: Roll dice. Build your lineup. Make the playoffs. Win a championship. Beat the target score before three outs to advance to the next inning. Win games, make the playoffs and win championships to unlock new players, Superfan boosts, cheat menus and more. Fall short, and your season is over. Every season is a chance to build something different. Recruit players with special abilities, add Superfan boosts, and upgrade your dice. Discover powerful combinations, stack multipliers, and turn modest hits into massive payoffs with one-time consumables and clever bench management. **BUILD YOUR WINNING COMBO** - Draft players with abilities that stay with you during the season. - Combine Superfan Boosts, dice upgrades, and items for powerful combos. - Face pitchers and boss closers who challenge your best strategies. - Unlock new players, Boosts, and ballparks as you progress. - Take on a fresh Daily Diamond challenge to earn an advantage during your season. - Enjoy turn-based gameplay at your own pace. - Play offline and pick up right where you left off. **FREE TO PLAY. NO ADS. EVER.** An optional, one-time in-app purchase unlocks customization and fun extras.

For example, type "g apple" to search for "apple" using Google, or "ddg apple" to search with DuckDuckGo. Privacy is a top priority: xSearch requests only the permissions it needs. On iOS 17, iPadOS 17, macOS 14 and later, it requires permission to view browsing history to function properly within Safari, but it only accesses the current session's URL to identify the search engine. title: Tanklet: Idle Fish Aquarium
summary: Tanklet is a cozy aquarium game where you raise a tank of fish that's truly yours. Feed them, clean the tank, keep the water healthy, and watch them drift through a beautifully rendered aquarium — all the joy and companionship of fishkeeping, none of the cost or mess. ■ Care for your fish Feed on schedule, clean the tank, and manage water quality. Well-cared-for fish stay healthy, happy, and earn more coins. Neglect them and they get listless or sick — but good care always brings them back. Your fish never die. ■ Rare visitors Wild fish drop by from time to time. Feed them, keep the water clean, and set out the decorations they love — treat them well and they may stay for good. The rarer the visitor, the pickier they are. ■ Personalities & bonds Every fish has its own personality. Greet them daily and serve their favorite treats to deepen your bond, unlocking little stories and rewards. ■ Collect & breed From clownfish, blue tang and angelfish to golden arowana and koi, collect distinctive species and fill your codex. Breed pairs for offspring, with a chance at rare variants and shiny fish. ■ Eggs with honest odds Hatch mystery eggs for new species — drop rates are disclosed before every purchase, with a pity system that guarantees rare finds. ■ Send fish on treasure hunts Pick 1–2 fish for expeditions to the reef, a shipwreck, or the deep abyss. Hours later they return with coins, decorations — sometimes even pearls. Strong bonds and healthy fish bring better luck. ■ Make the tank yours Buy and freely place plants, driftwood, rocks and more. Resize, restyle, and decorate your tank exactly how you like it. ■ More tanks, real ecosystems Save up for a second and third tank: freshwater, saltwater and coral ecosystems each boost matching fish. Every tank has its own theme and decorations, and fish can move anytime. ■ Ambient Mode: put your tank in a room Hide the interface and let your tank live in a warm little room. Nine rooms to swap — an indigo moon window, a brick loft, a green library, a coastal cottage… each room's light truly falls into the water. Keep the screen on and it becomes living furniture. ■ Grows while you're away Close the app and your fish keep you company while coins keep accruing. Come back to collect offline earnings and see what happened. ■ Calm, anywhere A Home Screen widget brings your tank to your desktop; soft water-sound ambience helps you unwind; iCloud keeps your tank in sync across devices. No ads, no third-party SDKs, zero data collection — your tank is yours alone. Subscribe to Tanklet+ for double coins, offline earnings extended 8→24 hours, auto-care while away, a monthly pearl gift, and exclusive decor. Slow down. Keep some fish. title: Oath & Ash
summary: Oath & Ash (Eid & Asche) is a turn-based fantasy card game with detailed art, animated hero portraits and punchy battle sound. It is fully playable with VoiceOver. Every card, every enemy move and every result is announced, and nothing is ever timed. THREE HEROES, THREE WAYS TO PLAY The Knight holds the line with armor, guard and counterattacks. The Hunter sets traps, spreads poison and outlasts the enemy. The Mage controls the flow of cards with chains and frost. The Hunter unlocks after Act I, the Mage after Act II. Each hero has their own cards, deck and progress. THREE ACTS Walk the Thorn Path, cross the Ashlands and brave the Sand Sea. Each act has ten encounters, its own enemies and boss fights. Enemies show their next move before they make it, so you can plan ahead. Losing costs you no progress. Change your deck and try again. COLLECT AND UPGRADE Win cards in battle or open card boxes with three random cards. The app shows the odds for each rarity before you open a box. Salvage duplicates for Dust and use it to upgrade your favorite cards. Your deck is yours to build. SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY Check the Daily tab for a new challenge each day, with its own rules and rewards. EXPEDITIONS Set out with a small deck and build it as you go. Three legs, each a map with branching paths to fights, rests, merchants and events, and a boss at the end. Relics give you lasting advantages, and your health carries over from fight to fight. In the weekly Expedition everyone plays the same map, and the top places in the ranking win weekly prizes. THE SEASON PATH Wins, duels and daily battles earn you embers to climb the Season Path: 40 levels of Dust, Diamonds, card boxes, titles, card backs, frames, avatars and victory lines. New looks arrive every month. The Path Letter opens a second track with more rewards. THE ARENA Duel the saved defense decks of real players. You play your turns, the game plays theirs. There is no turn timer, and every deck fights with its real card levels, so deckbuilding and tactics decide. If no player is a good match, a clearly labeled Arena Guardian steps in for half points. Climb from Starter through Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum to Diamond. Each season lasts one month, and the ranking shows your display name and avatar. Challenge friends to friendly duels with an invite link, and every profile shows league, heroes and collection. BUILT FOR VOICEOVER • Every value, card text and enemy intent is spoken • No time pressure, in the acts or in the Arena • Battle log with one heading per round for quick navigation • Narrator Helmut guides you in English and German • Every enemy has a voice of its own, and every boss its own music and entrance • You can hear when it's your turn, how hard a hit landed and when your health runs low • Settings, Learn the sounds lets you hear every sound and what it means • Support for larger text, reduced motion and haptic feedback GOOD TO KNOW Your progress is saved to your iCloud account, so you need to be signed in to iCloud on your device. Battles, Expeditions and the Arena need an internet connection. Your collection and the tutorial also work offline. Diamonds and the Path Letter are optional in-app purchases. There are no ads. Questions or problems? Reach us at support.kroegoor.com.

title: Upward: Number Merge Puzzle
summary: Drop a number. Set off a chain. Climb to Orbit. Only the bottom rungs ever fall. Drop a number into one of five columns, watch equal numbers double where they touch, and let gravity chain one merge into the next — climbing 2 Pebble all the way to 512 Orbit. NO ADS. NO LIVES. NO BOOSTS. No ads, no consumable lives to wait out, and nothing you can buy to raise a score. Pro is a one-time unlock or a Play Pass — or nothing at all. PLAN THE CLIMB See the piece in hand and the next two pieces before you commit. Choose a column, set up connected matches, and build chain reactions that can transform the whole board. ONE SHARED DAILY Every player starts with the same Daily seed and 50-drop rules. Later pieces respond to your climb, so planning the ladder matters. 16 FIXED CHALLENGES Learn Upward through four chapters of authored, repeatable boards. The four-stage Trailhead chapter is free. Pro opens Ridgecraft, Thin Air, and Orbit School, with XP and board-theme rewards along the way. FIVE WAYS TO PLAY • Daily Climb — the shared 50-drop board • Classic — an open climb to Orbit • Blitz — two minutes, no take-backs • Chain Hunt — 50 drops with bonus points for deep cascades • Rising Sky — safe board space contracts every 10 drops BUILT TO FEEL GOOD Number-first tiles stay readable across every theme. Landing feedback, escalating haptics, rising chain tones, danger states, and a full Orbit celebration make every important move clear. WHAT FREE INCLUDES Free players receive the full Daily Climb, the Daily and Classic leaderboards, three Classic starts per day, the four-stage Trailhead, missions, achievements, and recent local progress. Upward Pro adds unlimited Classic, three specialty modes, 12 advanced challenges, 500-run history, two years of Daily archives, the Blitz leaderboard, friend challenges, Daily history sync, and two more board themes. Choose a one-time Upward Full Game Unlock, or StackForge Play Pass (monthly or annual) — Pro in every StackForge game plus One Good Thing. Prices and renewal terms appear before purchase. title: Sortalis
summary: Sortalis is a dice-building roguelike inspired by Farkle. Roll, score, and decide how far you’re willing to push your luck—then spend your winnings on Charms and upgrades that transform your dice, strengthen your strategy, and rewrite the rules. Every run becomes a new engine to build, exploit, and inevitably push a little too far. **What’s in the game?** • Endless challenges that grow tougher and demand new strategies • Over 150 upgrades to discover and combine into powerful builds • Rewards, unlocks, achievements, Dice Bags, and challenges to master • Multiplayer draft mode! **Roll, Set, or Bank** Roll and select scoring combos carefully. Roll again to make it bigger—or Farkle and lose the lot. Bank before your luck runs out. **Spend It in The Shop** Between Bouts, spend your winnings on Charms, Packs, Action Cards, and other upgrades. Don’t like what’s on the shelf? Redraw it and hunt for the piece your build needs. **Face The House** Every night ends with a boss that changes the rules. THE MISER, for example, won’t let you Bank until your Pot reaches 500. **Then Do It All Again** Every Bank and Farkle adds to your final score. Unlock 14 Dice Bags, tabletops, discover new combinations, and see how far you can push your next run.

title: Decant: Color Sort Puzzle
summary: Pour a little color. Make a little order. Decant is a color-sort puzzle with luminous glass vessels and a simple goal: leave each filled vessel with just one color. Tap a vessel, choose a matching color or an empty space, and pour the top group. Two spare vessels give you room to think—not a shortcut to buy. NO ADS. ROOM TO PLAY. - 180 puzzles across four difficulty levels, each checked for a solution. - A fresh, always-free Daily, with the same ranked board and rules for everyone. - Practice puzzles generated and checked before you play. - Satisfying glass pours—or instant pours when you prefer to skip the animation. - Liquid symbols, a high-contrast palette, and sound, haptic, handedness, and motion controls. - Free restarts. No lives, energy, timers, or extra vessels for sale. Find a solution, then try to make it cleaner. A Perfect clear uses the fewest possible pours. Older archived Daily puzzles may show a Target instead; that is a reference solution, not a promise of the minimum. START FREE. UNLOCK MORE IF YOU LIKE. The first 30 puzzles, today's Daily, and three practice puzzles per day are free, with three undos per board. The Daily does not count against your practice allowance. A one-time Decant Full Game Unlock opens all 180 puzzles, unlimited practice and undos outside the ranked Daily, the full Daily archive for unranked practice, and advanced records. Or choose the StackForge Play Pass for Pro access across StackForge games and One Good Thing. Prices are shown before purchase. Play Pass subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Today's ranked Daily gives every player the same three undos, whether free or Pro. No ads in either tier. Optional account sync keeps your progress and Play Pass connected.
